title: The Place the LORD Will Choose
aka: to make his name live there
lead: Deuteronomy commands Israel to bring its sacrifices, tithes and feasts to one place that God will choose "to make his name live there" (Deuteronomy 12:5–14). The book never names it. Later books identify it with Jerusalem and its temple (1 Kings 8:29; 2 Kings 23), while Samaritans identify it with Mount Gerizim, and Jesus says true worship is no longer tied to either mountain (John 4:20–24).
